scope: Independent source-only semantic review of the ten-source actual four-arm phase; not full-paper/runtime completion or remote CI
semantic_checks: ResidualForestPaths uses actual native walks, connected subset boundary and degree<=2 in an acyclic graph to construct a spanning simple path.
WeightedPathPrefixes recursively chooses an actual first threshold prefix. WeightedPathArms selects opposite affixes of the supplied simple path; their only common vertex is the actual center.
Four-arm mass counts each center once: total mass>=4L-2(D+1). Carrier disjointness prevents inter-center duplication.

Connected carrier size minus one is charged to actual internal coarse edges. The internal-edge inclusion used to enlarge the eligible union has the correct direction and is multiplied only by nonnegative c.
The 7/8 versus1/8 credit split algebra exactly supports diameter2(L+D)+M, incident qM per selected old vertex, and reserve cb/2 under8qM<=cb and15D+4M+15+2b<=6L.

Native original-host lifts subtract the effective-mass +1 once, yielding each arm-to-center cost<=L+D. Cross-center paths traverse the actual heavy bridge once; same-center paths need no bridge. All supports stay inside the branch union.
FourArmCore is witnessed by four actual paths and an original B edge, with no output budget/diameter predicate as a premise. The original-disjoint-path wrapper builds the arm witnesses internally.

The finite maximum ranges over all witnessed carriers inside R and constructs a disjoint packing; the nonempty-carrier augmenting argument proves no remaining eligible disjoint carrier. Empty packing is correctly permitted.
The final hcover over every original vertex is essential and explicit. It makes touchingEdges cover every incident B edge, including edges to unselected old clusters.
Weighted girth plus old intrinsic diameter/light-heavy hypotheses derive no internal heavy loops and unique heavy fibers, rather than assuming the desired edge-payment oracle.
One fixed crossing-edge embedding maps coarse connectors to distinct actual unit host edges. Disjoint cores have disjoint connector credit, with exact weight/cardinality equality.
The supplied H is an actual subgraph of C.graph T; the final four-arm phase does not require H acyclic. The residual-forest spanning-path theorem has its own explicit acyclicity premise.
explicit_boundaries: Old cluster family and full cover, intrinsic per-cluster path certificates, old credits, residual set R, low degrees and the two numerical credit bounds remain explicit input invariants.
Residual exclusion covers eligible pairs of disjoint far-endpoint paths; it does not assert all residual heavy edges are paid.
Same-path short cycles, endpoint absorption/deferred edges, hierarchy iteration, global multilevel lightness and runtime remain open.
No compiler, kernel replay or remote Git/CI check was run by this reviewer. Existing owner gates are separate evidence; remote binding is still required after publication.
